name: Landscape Intelligence Lab
tagline: Model a site's climate and water basis and score a landscape design's sustainability performance.
description: Builds a site's climate baseline (a monthly rainfall/ETo chart for the chosen city), runs a water-use analysis, and scores a landscape design's sustainability performance against it — planting and materials choices included — exporting a PDF report.

page.objective: Score a landscape design against its own site's climate and water reality, not a generic checklist.
page.problem: Landscape sustainability is normally assessed against generic guidance rather than the specific site's climate and water baseline.
page.solution: A city climate pack and site area drive a climate/water baseline, and planting and materials choices are scored against it into an assurance score and report.

highlights.headline: A climate-and-water baseline that scores a landscape design's sustainability performance.
points: Builds a city climate baseline — a monthly rainfall/ETo chart with verified stat cards.
Runs a dedicated Water Lab pass on the site's water use.
Produces an assurance score and an exportable PDF report from the same model.
